purpose: DICOMCBCTRecon is a 3D Slicer scripted module and DICOM plugin that enables cone-beam CT reconstruction (FDK and SART algorithms) of rotational C-arm X-ray acquisitions (XA/XRF multi-frame DICOM) using PyTorch.
summary: DICOMCBCTRecon is a well-structured 3D Slicer extension providing cone-beam CT reconstruction (FDK, SART, 3D DSA subtraction) for rotational X-ray angiography (XA/XRF) runs loaded through the DICOM browser. It adheres to all Slicer conventions, utilizes PyTorch correctly via PyTorchUtils, includes robust error handling and self-tests, and features an MIT license. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: No malicious code, no arbitrary network connections, secure use of pydicom and SimpleITK, proper PyTorch usage through PyTorchUtils.

environment.rationale: PyTorch is correctly required via build_dependencies and PyTorchUtils without side effects at import or package pinning.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and module CMakeLists.txt correctly declare all Python scripts and resources.

license.rationale: Standard MIT License permitting distribution and usage.

soundness.rationale: Clean ScriptedLoadableModule architecture with proper error handling, unit tests, and resource cleanup.

utility.rationale: Comprehensive documentation, tutorial/self-test, and clear purpose addressing rotational XA/XRF cone-beam CT reconstruction.

not_checked: DICOMCBCTReconLib/reconstruction.py (PyTorch tensor operations, cone-beam backprojection/forward projection and filtering math)
DICOMCBCTReconLib/geometry.py and gecalib.py (projection geometry matrices and calibration)
